none: PAS SWYOR-ED5DCE: A Roman coin: a denarius of Tiberius
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Tiberius dating from AD 14 - 37 (Reece period 1), the reverse legend PONTIF MAXIM (retrograde). The reverse depicts a female figure, seated right on a chair with ornate legs, holding a sceptre and olive branch, a single line below. The mint Lyon. Reference: RIC I, number 30.
